summary: P2 feature testing: email encryption, auto sign-out (sessionStorage), screenshot prevention. Found 1 CRITICAL blocking bug (TDZ crash, fixed), 2 HIGH backend bugs, and 1 medium migration gap. All backend login/admin/network APIs pass (18/19 tests; 1 failure on /me email decryption).

critical.issue: Returns raw Fernet-encrypted email (gAAAAABq...) instead of decrypted email. The get_me() function decrypts 'location' but forgot to decrypt 'email'. Missing: user['email'] = safe_decrypt(user.get('email', '')). This affects any code in React that reads user.email from the auth context after page reload (checkAuth calls /me).

Seeding code does db.users.find_one({'email': admin_email}) with plaintext email. Since admin email is now Fernet-encrypted in DB, lookup returns None, and a NEW duplicate admin user 'Admin' is created with plaintext email on EVERY server restart. DB now has 2 admins with email deathproofrebel@protonmail.com. Fix: use $or with email_hash lookup: {'$or': [{'email_hash': hash_email(admin_email)}, {'email': admin_email}]}

minor.issue: Email search (@-containing queries) uses ONLY email_hash lookup. Legacy users created BEFORE P2 encryption (e.g., TEST_P1_BanUser) have no email_hash and cannot be found by email. No fallback to plaintext email for legacy users in email search path. Consider adding: {'$or': [{'email_hash': hash_email(query)}, {'email': query.lower()}, {'public_id': query.upper()}]}

action_items: Fix GET /api/auth/me (routes/auth.py): add `user['email'] = safe_decrypt(user.get('email', ''))` before returning the user dict

Fix server.py startup seeding: change find_one({'email': admin_email}) to find_one({'$or': [{'email_hash': hash_email(admin_email)}, {'email': admin_email}]}) and import hash_email in server.py. Also clean up the duplicate 'Admin' user that was created.
Optional: add plaintext fallback in network search for legacy users without email_hash
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js FIXED: TDZ crash - logout was declared AFTER the useEffect that referenced it in dependency array [user, logout]. Caused ReferenceError: Cannot access 'logout' before initialization → complete black screen. Fixed by moving logout declaration before the useEffect.
routes/auth.py get_me(): decrypts location but NOT email. Missing: user['email'] = safe_decrypt(user.get('email', '')).
server.py startup: find_one({'email': admin_email}) will always return None for encrypted email users, creating duplicate user every restart.

database.py hash_email() uses hmac_module.new() which is deprecated in Python 3.x (uses hmac.new). Should use hmac.new() from the hmac module directly. Actually: `import hmac as hmac_module` then `hmac_module.new(key, msg, digest).hexdigest()` is correct syntax.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P2 frontend features working after TDZ fix)

seed_data_creation: Duplicate admin user 'Admin' was created during server restart due to seeding bug. DB has 3 users: Bob (original admin, id=6a483bbd8ebfbb9b7696ee5a, encrypted email, email_hash set), Admin (duplicate, plaintext email, no email_hash), TEST_P1_BanUser (test user, plaintext email, no email_hash - created before P2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 features mostly working. CRITICAL FIX APPLIED: logout TDZ in AuthContext.js fixed (moved logout declaration before useEffect that uses it). Backend bugs remain: (1) /me endpoint returns encrypted email - add safe_decrypt in get_me(), (2) server.py seeding creates duplicate admin on restart - fix find_one to use email_hash. DB has duplicate admin 'Admin' user that should be cleaned up. TEST_P1_BanUser can't be found by email search (no email_hash - created before P2). Verified working: login (HMAC hash lookup), admin users list (decrypted), sessionStorage tokens, no screenshot-protected class for admin, no blur overlay for admin, Trader ID visible on profile page.

tzdfix.bug: AuthContext.js: const logout = useCallback(...) declared at line 168, but useEffect at line 104-121 has [user, logout] in dependency array. In non-Babel-transpiled modern JS environments, this causes ReferenceError: Cannot access 'logout' before initialization (TDZ). The entire React app crashes on load - complete black screen.
tzdfix.reproduction: Clear sessionStorage, load app - immediate black screen with console error 'Cannot access logout before initialization'
tzdfix.fix: Moved logout useCallback declaration to line 103 (BEFORE the useEffect that references it). Fixed in this iteration.

me_endpoint_email.bug: routes/auth.py get_me() returns raw user dict from MongoDB without decrypting email field. Location is decrypted (try/except block) but email is not. After page refresh, checkAuth() calls /me which returns encrypted email, setting user.email = 'gAAAAABq...' in React state.
me_endpoint_email.fix: Add user['email'] = safe_decrypt(user.get('email', '')) in get_me() before returning the user dict.

seeding_bug.bug: server.py startup seeding: db.users.find_one({'email': admin_email}) searches by plaintext email. After P2 migration, admin email is stored as Fernet token (gAAAA...). Lookup returns None, create new user runs, creates duplicate admin 'Admin' with plaintext email.
seeding_bug.fix: Change seeding lookup to: db.users.find_one({'$or': [{'email_hash': hash_email(admin_email)}, {'email': admin_email}]}). Requires importing hash_email from database in server.py.

verified_p2_features.email_encryption: Login works via HMAC hash lookup for migrated admin. Login response returns decrypted email. /api/admin/users returns decrypted emails. Fernet migration confirmed (Bob has email_hash=True in DB).
verified_p2_features.session_storage: rtn_access_token and rtn_refresh_token stored in sessionStorage. Not in localStorage. Verified via JS evaluation.
verified_p2_features.screenshot_prevention_admin: Admin (privileged) has NO screenshot-protected class. Admin has NO rtn-watermark. Admin has NO security-blur-overlay. Dashboard app-shell classes: ['app-shell'] only.
verified_p2_features.blur_overlay: Window blur event listeners NOT attached for admin (isPrivileged check works). Verified: no security-blur-overlay visible.
verified_p2_features.trader_id_profile: Profile page shows 'YOUR TRADER ID: N9TMTL6B' with 'Share this ID so others can find you' text. Copy button present.
verified_p2_features.visibilitychange_listener: visibilitychange event listener attached via useEffect when user is logged in. 30-min SESSION_IDLE_MS timer set on document.hidden. Verified by code review.
